name: A Link Between Twilight
author: WadeWinningWilson
description: A Link Between Twilight — full gameplay plugin for stock Dusklight (multiplatform, one bundle for all hosts). ALBW-style meter, wolf/Midna combat, Focused Arts, Hurricane Spin, Deku Leaf glide, refined boss fights, and more. Standalone feature dusks remain separate — do not load both.
